title: Secure Media Endpoints Certificate Validation (Stage)
product-requirement: Device needs to present a valid client certificate in order to access the BBC's secure media endpoints.
specification: When accessing BBC services over HTTPS, each terminal MUST present its TLS certificate if prompted to by the server; thus identifying the terminal model. (2.1 Terminal Authentication)
assertion: Make a JSONP request to the stage mediaselector endpoints. If a response is received within 10 seconds then the certificate is valid.
